Large parts are genuinely correct and I re-derived them: 291/172 frozen vs 283/164 prior with exactly `cinema-oct3-005..012` added and all 283 prior objects byte-identical; baseline archive `5ab6a34e` and archived api/nginx pins match; the full cutover transformation contract replays cleanly on the real archive (including the subtle "95ad1112 appears twice, once inside the replaced preflight"), 3 preflight boundaries each carrying the strict 20% guard; all 148 web-tree files and all 7 frozen assets rehash exactly, in both builds, against the frozen commit; 25 screenshots + 8 footer hashes match (I viewed two — four headed sections, two source links, no textarea).
